messages.content: Translate the question into Italian if it is in English, into English if it is in Italian. Keep names, numbers and dates. Return only the translation.
Must the UR10e robot, as delivered by the manufacturer, bear the CE mark under the Machinery Directive?

response.text: Deve il robot UR10e, così come fornito dal costruttore, recare la marcatura CE ai sensi della Direttiva Macchine?
